what_happened: All four claims of lem:canonical-frames were discharged first-try in standalone probe files compiled with 'lake env lean' against the existing .olean cache (no lake build needed): (a) determinism via fib_subsingleton_of_functional, (b) the H_F = {sigma_c} Equiv, (c) the Limit-iff-Discrete biconditional, (d) non-determinism plus the assignment bijection. Research hands the planner proven proof scripts rather than sketches.

C15 (check-module-invariants) requires every paper-anchor citation to resolve against docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md, and neither def:canonical-frames nor lem:canonical-frames has a MANIFEST or KNOWN-ANCHORS row. The dispatch mandates docstrings citing both anchors, so implementation MUST edit that record file -- which is in concurrent task 756's declared file_scope.

RealTranslationFrame.lean's documented 'symptom 2' barrier is real: any '+' expression containing a 'tau.state t' subterm fails HAdd synthesis, because translationFrame is a plain def and instance search does not unfold it. Type ascription does NOT repair it (binop% reads the operand's inferred type). Repaired by a 'def translationStates (tau) : ↑D → ↑D := tau.state' view, on the WorldHistory.path precedent.

scripts/check-paper-definitions.sh already FAILS on the live tree with 26 drifted anchors (pre-existing, not caused by this task). It is continue-on-error in CI and skipped there, so it is advisory; implementation should take the KNOWN-ANCHORS LIVE-UNPINNED route rather than pinning new sha rows into a record with a pending drift wave.

The research round left all 23 declarations compiled under lake env lean with proofs reproduced verbatim in its Appendix, so planning was pure transcription sequencing: no discovery, no tactic exploration, and the Lean Challenge Statements block could be written directly from the measured signatures. Identifier-set equality against the Goals list verified mechanically with the snapshot script's own extraction logic (23 == 23).

Three mechanical obligations absent from the research report were re-derived at plan time. (1) A concurrently dispatched sibling has work STAGED IN THE SHARED GIT INDEX right now (Presheaf/*, PartialHistory.lean, untracked Gluing.lean), so any bare git commit from this task would sweep it in -- the plan mandates git-commit-scoped.sh --task 790 with explicit pathspecs at every commit. (2) The gate set is ALREADY RED on entry (C6, C15, C33, C35, INV, typst MISMATCH_COUNT=2) and the failing set MOVED between two consecutive runs minutes apart as the sibling wrote, so 'gate exits 0' is unachievable as a closure criterion; the plan's final phase re-derives an entry baseline and requires the failing set afterwards to be a subset of it. (3) Root README.md's dir=FormalSystem generated block carries whole-tree line totals that this task's ~185 added lines drift, and both it and typst/generated/status.typ are in the sibling's declared file_scope -- the plan makes regeneration a decision gate with an explicit defer-and-record branch.

Entry gate baseline re-derived at implement time is GREEN, not red as the plan measured at plan time: bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --no-build exits 0 with both C15 anchor-integrity assertions passing (67 citations, 289 theorem-index rows). The sibling that had work staged in the shared git index at plan time has committed (HEAD 26a54413b) and git status --short shows no foreign Lean modification, so Phase 7's subset-of-baseline closure criterion can be the stronger exit-0 criterion instead.

Two of the research round's compiled proofs used the 'show' tactic to beta-reduce a goal (translationSigma_zero, translation_eq_sigma). Compiled standalone under lake env lean they were clean, but inside the library build the linter.style.show lint fires ('this tactic invocation changed the goal; use change instead'), which the plan's per-phase verification criterion 'no linter finding' forbids. Replaced both with 'change' (same goal, lint-clean) and pre-applied the same substitution to the prepared Phase 3 translationHistEquiv right_inv proof. Lesson: a research-round 'lake env lean' probe does not exercise the house style linters that the library build enables.

The plan's per-phase and Testing-and-Validation criterion '#print axioms on at least one declaration per claim reports no choice axiom' is unachievable and was mis-derived at plan time (the research round never ran #print axioms). Measured: translationFrame itself depends on [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], as do translationHist, translationFrame_taskRel, translation_realizes and permissiveHist -- every pre-existing declaration naming either canonical frame. FrameOver.ofReflectiveRegular is choice-free ([propext]), so the choice enters through translationFrame's own IsRegular obligations, inside a definition this dispatch forbids changing. Consequence: every new declaration about these frames inherits Classical.choice, and no new axiom DEPENDENCY is introduced by this task (the honest reading of the constraint, which the dispatch states as 'no new sorry' plus a green build). Recorded rather than papered over; named in the implementation summary.

The plan deferred typst/generated/status.typ regeneration to Phase 7 behind a decision gate, but a pre-commit hook (scripts/typst-sync-check.sh Check 2) BLOCKS any commit staging a .lean file whose lines the generated whole-tree count no longer reflects. The Phase 2 commit was refused outright with exit 1, and git-commit-scoped.sh's V8 gate then additionally reported 'present with different content' -- a misleading additive diagnostic, since no commit had been created at all. Resolution: run bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix and stage typst/generated/status.typ in the SAME commit as the Lean file, which the hook requires; this is a per-phase obligation, not a Phase 7 one. Attribution verified clean: the count moved 354785 -> 354896, exactly the 111 insertions of this commit, with no foreign uncommitted .lean changes in the tree. --no-verify was NOT used (the hook's sanctioned bypass covers only drift from another writer's uncommitted files).

Phase 7 closure is the STRONGER criterion than the plan's subset-of-baseline: the whole gate set is green at exit. check-module-invariants.sh (build-enabled) exits 0 with ALL CHECKS PASSED (C3 structural sorry zero, C15 both anchor assertions over 69 citations, C19 refined docstring coverage 90.64% above its 90% floor, C23 zero live lemma, C24 Init reachability, C33 generated root byte-current, C35 citation manifest byte-current); typst-sync-check.sh PASS on all 4 checks; readme-lint.sh RESULT PASS; check-copyright-headers.sh --strict FormalSystem exit 0; verify-deploy.sh PASS with 15 checks and 0 failures; guarded unscoped lake build exit 0 over 2848 jobs with zero error lines and zero warnings, and the .olean for both touched modules newer than its source. The generated-counts decision gate took the REGENERATE branch: no sibling had uncommitted .lean changes, and each regenerated field was checked to move by exactly this task's own growth (typst line count per Lean commit; root README live code +129 and comment +194 lines; RealTranslationFrame row 196->201 and Independence/ total 7652->7657).
